pages.title: Scan, Disc, Print
pages.text: The whole loop: $(l)scan$() a build with the Structure Scanner, save it to a $(l)disc$(), then $(l)print$() it anywhere a printer can reach.

Scans are stored as $(l)blueprints$() in the world save; a $(item)Blueprint Disc$() is the key that references one. Shift+Right Click a written disc to $(l)lock$() it against being overwritten.$(br2)Discs also turn up in $(l)village and exploration loot$() — print what you find, no scanning required.

pages.title: Import & Export
pages.text: Operators can exchange blueprints with other tools:$(br)$(li)$(o)/mc3dprint import <file>$() reads WorldEdit $(l).schem$() and Create / vanilla $(l).nbt$() files from $(o)world/mc3dprint/import/$()$(li)$(o)/mc3dprint export$() writes the disc in your hand to a $(l).schem$()$(br2)Shipped blueprints live in $(o)world/mc3dprint/blueprints/$().
